mapper.select: select application_scope_id as applicationId,usage_date as usageDate, capability,billing_owner as billingOwner,currency,request_count as requestCount,success_count as successCount, failure_count as failureCount,unknown_count as unknownCount,cancelled_count as cancelledCount, input_tokens as inputTokens,output_tokens as outputTokens,input_chars as inputChars,image_count as imageCount, audio_duration_ms as audioDurationMs,known_usage_count as knownUsageCount,known_cost_count as knownCostCount, cost_amount as costAmount from p_usage_daily order by usage_date desc,application_scope_id,capability,currency limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from p_usage_daily

select c.id as callId,c.application_id as applicationId,c.capability, c.status,c.billing_owner as billingOwner,c.input_tokens as inputTokens,c.output_tokens as outputTokens, c.input_chars as inputChars,c.image_count as imageCount,c.audio_duration_ms as audioDurationMs, c.usage_available as usageAvailable,c.cost_amount as costAmount,c.currency,c.cost_source as costSource, case when p.id is null then null when c.capability='GENERATION' then p.unit_price_cent/100.0 when p.state='SETTLED' then p.settled_cent/100.0 else p.reserved_cent/100.0 end pointAmount, p.state pointState,c.error_code as errorCode,c.created_at as createdAt,c.updated_at as updatedAt from p_call_record c left join p_point_reservation p on p.id=c.quota_reservation_id order by c.created_at desc,c.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from p_call_record c

select convert(quota_type using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_unicode_ci as quotaType,granted_units as grantedUnits, used_units as usedUnits,reserved_units as reservedUnits, granted_units-used_units-reserved_units as availableUnits,revision from p_quota_balance where account_id=#{accountId} and quota_type='STORAGE_BYTE' union all select convert('POINT' using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_unicode_ci,granted_cent/100.0,used_cent/100.0,reserved_cent/100.0, (granted_cent-used_cent-reserved_cent)/100.0,revision from p_point_balance where account_id=#{accountId} order by quotaType

select id as reservationId, convert(quota_type using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_unicode_ci as quotaType, convert(business_type using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_unicode_ci as businessType, convert(business_id using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_unicode_ci as businessId,reservation_no as reservationNo, reserved_units as reservedUnits,settled_units as settledUnits, convert(state using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_unicode_ci as state,created_at as createdAt, expires_at as expiresAt,settled_at as settledAt,released_at as releasedAt, null billingItem,null measuredUnits,null unitPrice from p_quota_reservation union all select id,convert('POINT' using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_unicode_ci, convert(business_type using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_unicode_ci, convert(business_id using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_unicode_ci,reservation_no,reserved_cent/100.0, settled_cent/100.0,convert(state using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_unicode_ci,created_at,null,settled_at,released_at, convert(billing_item using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_unicode_ci,measured_units,unit_price_cent/100.0 from p_point_reservation where account_id=#{accountId} and state=#{state} order by createdAt desc,reservationId desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select (select count(*) from p_quota_reservation )+ (select count(*) from p_point_reservation where account_id=#{accountId} and state=#{state})

select users.totalUsers,users.activeUsers, balances.pointAccounts,balances.grantedPoints,balances.usedPoints,balances.reservedPoints, balances.availablePoints,calls.usageUsers,calls.requestCount,calls.successCount,calls.failureCount, calls.unknownCount,calls.imageCount,calls.inputChars,calls.audioDurationMs from (select count(*) totalUsers,coalesce(sum(u.status='0'),0) activeUsers from sys_user u where u.del_flag='0' and exists (select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id where ur.user_id=u.user_id and r.role_key='developer')) users cross join (select count(*) pointAccounts,coalesce(sum(b.granted_cent),0)/100.0 grantedPoints, coalesce(sum(b.used_cent),0)/100.0 usedPoints,coalesce(sum(b.reserved_cent),0)/100.0 reservedPoints, coalesce(sum(b.granted_cent-b.used_cent-b.reserved_cent),0)/100.0 availablePoints from p_point_balance b where exists (select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id where ur.user_id=b.account_id and r.role_key='developer')) balances cross join (select count(distinct c.account_id) usageUsers,count(*) requestCount, coalesce(sum(c.status='SUCCEEDED'),0) successCount, coalesce(sum(c.status='FAILED'),0) failureCount,coalesce(sum(c.status='UNKNOWN'),0) unknownCount, coalesce(sum(c.image_count),0) imageCount,coalesce(sum(c.input_chars),0) inputChars, coalesce(sum(c.audio_duration_ms),0) audioDurationMs from p_call_record c where c.created_at >= #{from} and c.created_at < date_add(#{to},interval 1 day) and exists (select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id where ur.user_id=c.account_id and r.role_key='developer')) calls

select c.capability,count(*) requestCount, coalesce(sum(c.status='SUCCEEDED'),0) successCount,coalesce(sum(c.status='FAILED'),0) failureCount, coalesce(sum(c.status='UNKNOWN'),0) unknownCount,coalesce(sum(c.image_count),0) imageCount, coalesce(sum(c.input_chars),0) inputChars,coalesce(sum(c.audio_duration_ms),0) audioDurationMs from p_call_record c where c.created_at >= #{from} and c.created_at < date_add(#{to},interval 1 day) and exists (select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id where ur.user_id=c.account_id and r.role_key='developer') group by c.capability order by requestCount desc,c.capability
mapper.sql: where u.del_flag='0' and exists (select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id where ur.user_id=u.user_id and r.role_key='developer') and (cast(u.user_id as char)=#{keyword} or u.user_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or u.nick_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or u.email like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))
mapper.select:
select u.user_id userId,u.user_name userName,u.nick_name nickName, u.email,u.status,u.create_time createdAt,coalesce(b.granted_cent,0)/100.0 grantedPoints, coalesce(b.used_cent,0)/100.0 usedPoints,coalesce(b.reserved_cent,0)/100.0 reservedPoints, coalesce(b.granted_cent-b.used_cent-b.reserved_cent,0)/100.0 availablePoints, coalesce(c.requestCount,0) requestCount,coalesce(c.successCount,0) successCount, coalesce(c.failureCount,0) failureCount,coalesce(c.unknownCount,0) unknownCount,c.lastCallAt from sys_user u left join p_point_balance b on b.account_id=u.user_id left join (select account_id,count(*) requestCount,sum(status='SUCCEEDED') successCount, sum(status='FAILED') failureCount,sum(status='UNKNOWN') unknownCount,max(created_at) lastCallAt from p_call_record where created_at >= #{from} and created_at < date_add(#{to},interval 1 day) group by account_id) c on c.account_id=u.user_id
order by coalesce(c.requestCount,0) desc,u.user_id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from sys_user u

select u.user_id userId,u.user_name userName,u.nick_name nickName, u.email,u.status,u.create_time createdAt from sys_user u where u.user_id=#{accountId} and u.del_flag='0' and exists (select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id where ur.user_id=u.user_id and r.role_key='developer')

select coalesce(b.granted_cent,0)/100.0 grantedPoints, coalesce(b.used_cent,0)/100.0 usedPoints,coalesce(b.reserved_cent,0)/100.0 reservedPoints, coalesce(b.granted_cent-b.used_cent-b.reserved_cent,0)/100.0 availablePoints, coalesce(c.requestCount,0) requestCount,coalesce(c.successCount,0) successCount, coalesce(c.failureCount,0) failureCount,coalesce(c.unknownCount,0) unknownCount, coalesce(c.imageCount,0) imageCount,coalesce(c.inputChars,0) inputChars, coalesce(c.audioDurationMs,0) audioDurationMs,c.lastCallAt from sys_user u left join p_point_balance b on b.account_id=u.user_id left join (select account_id,count(*) requestCount,sum(status='SUCCEEDED') successCount, sum(status='FAILED') failureCount,sum(status='UNKNOWN') unknownCount,sum(image_count) imageCount, sum(input_chars) inputChars,sum(audio_duration_ms) audioDurationMs,max(created_at) lastCallAt from p_call_record where account_id=#{accountId} and created_at >= #{from} and created_at < date_add(#{to},interval 1 day) group by account_id) c on c.account_id=u.user_id where u.user_id=#{accountId}

select capability,count(*) requestCount, coalesce(sum(status='SUCCEEDED'),0) successCount,coalesce(sum(status='FAILED'),0) failureCount, coalesce(sum(status='UNKNOWN'),0) unknownCount,coalesce(sum(image_count),0) imageCount, coalesce(sum(input_chars),0) inputChars,coalesce(sum(audio_duration_ms),0) audioDurationMs from p_call_record where account_id=#{accountId} and created_at >= #{from} and created_at < date_add(#{to},interval 1 day) group by capability order by requestCount desc,capability
select user_id from sys_user where user_id=#{accountId} for update
mapper.delete: delete from p_usage_daily where account_id=#{accountId} and usage_date=#{date}
mapper.insert: insert into p_usage_daily (id,created_at,updated_at,account_id,application_scope_id,usage_date,capability,billing_owner, request_count,success_count,failure_count,unknown_count,cancelled_count,input_tokens,output_tokens, input_chars,image_count,audio_duration_ms,known_usage_count,known_cost_count,cost_amount,currency,expires_at) select uuid_short(),utc_timestamp(3),utc_timestamp(3),account_id,coalesce(application_id,0),date(created_at), capability,billing_owner,count(*),sum(status='SUCCEEDED'),sum(status='FAILED'),sum(status='UNKNOWN'), sum(status='CANCELLED'),sum(coalesce(input_tokens,0)),sum(coalesce(output_tokens,0)), sum(coalesce(input_chars,0)),sum(coalesce(image_count,0)),sum(coalesce(audio_duration_ms,0)), sum(usage_available=1),sum(cost_amount is not null),sum(coalesce(cost_amount,0)),coalesce(currency,'UNKNOWN'),null from p_call_record where account_id=#{accountId} and created_at >= #{date} and created_at < date_add(#{date},interval 1 day) group by account_id,coalesce(application_id,0),date(created_at),capability,billing_owner,coalesce(currency,'UNKNOWN')
mapper.select: select id,account_id as accountId,quota_type as quotaType, reserved_units as reservedUnits,state from p_quota_reservation where id=#{id}
select id,account_id as accountId,quota_type as quotaType, reserved_units as reservedUnits,state from p_quota_reservation where id=#{id} for update
select id from p_quota_balance where account_id=#{accountId} and quota_type=#{quotaType} for update
mapper.update: update p_quota_reservation set state=#{state},settled_units=#{settledUnits}, settled_at=case when #{state}='SETTLED' then utc_timestamp(3) else settled_at end, released_at=case when #{state}='RELEASED' then utc_timestamp(3) else released_at end, updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and state='REVIEW_REQUIRED'

update p_quota_balance set reserved_units=reserved_units-#{reservedUnits}, used_units=used_units+#{settledUnits},revision=revision+1,updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where account_id=#{accountId} and quota_type=#{quotaType} and reserved_units >= #{reservedUnits} and used_units+#{settledUnits} <= granted_units
mapper.select: select user_id from sys_user where user_id=#{accountId} and status='0' and del_flag='0'
select user_id from sys_user where user_id=#{accountId} and status='0' and del_flag='0' for update
mapper.update: update p_account_limit set max_file_bytes=#{maxFileBytes}, max_sessions=#{maxSessions},max_generation_tasks=#{maxGenerationTasks},max_turns=#{maxTurns}, revision=revision+1,updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where account_id=#{accountId} and revision=#{revision}
mapper.select: select quota_type as quotaType,delta_granted as units,reason from p_quota_entry where account_id=#{accountId} and event_key=#{eventKey}
select granted_units as grantedUnits, used_units as usedUnits,reserved_units as reservedUnits from p_quota_balance where account_id=#{accountId} and quota_type=#{quotaType} for update
